title: Add streaming-chunk-boundary-metrics and ephemeral-cache-guilt-scorer
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Added new streaming-chunk-boundary metrics and an ephemeral-cache guilt scorer. These metrics enable fine-grained SLO attribution for streaming workloads and a new signal to auto-mute noisy cache churn. No behavioral changes to public APIs.
description: Context: Streaming inference workloads have an additional source of latency variance and token-cost leakage at chunk boundaries (when client chunks are concatenated or re-streamed). Existing token-level telemetry aggregates over whole invocations and misses short-lived boundary effects that drive tail latency and double-counted KV cache churn. Motivation: provide operators and SREs a lightweight signal to separate steady-state token cost from boundary-induced overheads, and a heuristic 'ephemeral-cache guilt' score to identify noisy clients or prompt patterns that cause excessive cache churn. What this PR does: 1) Introduces a set of streaming-chunk-boundary metrics emitted from the streaming runtime: stream.chunk_boundary.count, stream.chunk_boundary.latency_ms_p50/p90/p99, stream.chunk_boundary.token_duplication_rate. 2) Adds ephemeral_cache.guilt_score as a composite metric (0..1) computed from short windowed KV miss rates, repeated prefix patterns, and intra-invocation re-fetch counts. 3) Exposes both signals to the observability pipeline with labels: tenant_id, model, route, stream_session_id, and boundary_type (client_split/server_split/retry). 4) Dashboard: new 'Streaming Chunk Health' Grafana panel group + a compact explainer panel that correlates guilt_score with per-route cost delta. 5) Alerts: a new low-noise alert rule that triggers when guilt_score > 0.6 for 5m and cost_delta > 2x baseline; alerts are auto-suppressed for sessions marked synthetic. 6) SDK telemetry: updates to the JS/TS SDK to tag streaming calls with chunk_id and to opt-in to boundary metrics via a boolean flag (off by default). Checklist: - [x] Runtime metric emission hooks implemented and tested with unit tests - [x] Guilt scorer proto and implementation with deterministic tests - [x] Added OpenTelemetry mapping and metric names to docs/config - [x] Grafana panels and dashboards committed as JSON - [x] Alerting rules added to repo and tested in staging - [x] SDK change behind feature flag; example added to quickstarts Rollout plan: feature gated in main branch but disabled by default. Will enable in staging for 48h with dashboard dashboards/streaming-health-staging.json, then progressively enable for 10% of production streaming sessions using server-side config. If guilt_score produces >5% false positives after 24h, rollout will be reverted. Testing: synthetic replay harness used to create chunk boundary cases (split at token offsets: 1, 16, 64) and validated metric stability and guardrails. Linear/Related: ENG-4321 (streaming SLO decomposition), ENG-4399 (kv-cache followups). Notes: This metric family is intentionally compact to avoid a cardinality explosion; boundary_type is a controlled enum. The guilt score is heuristic by design and is documented in docs/observability/streaming-guilt.md. Implementation details and rationale included in the PR description body below.
commits: a1f9c3b: runtime: emit stream.chunk_boundary.* metrics at boundary detection points
b2e44cd: scoring: implement ephemeral_cache.guilt_score prototype and deterministic unit tests
c3d7f58: telemetry: map new metrics to OTEL names and add tenant/model labels
d4fa2a1: sdk/ts: attach chunk_id and feature flag for boundary telemetry
e5bb4e0: docs: add streaming-guilt.md and update observability index
f6c3b91: infra: add grafana panels and staging alert rule; update k8s config
changed_snippets: stream_chunk_meter.go: emitMetric("stream.chunk_boundary.count", 1, labels) // called when boundary detected

streaming-guilt-rule.yaml: alert: StreamingEphemeralCacheGuilt
expr: ephemeral_cache_guilt_score{job=~"streaming.*"} > 0.6 and increase(route_cost_delta[5m]) > 0
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: warning
review_discussion: Diego Ramos (2026-02-19): Nice approach. Can we avoid adding tenant_id to high-cardinality labels? Suggest using tenant_tier for SLO alerting and keep tenant_id only in a debug sink.
Asha Menon (2026-02-19): Good catch — switched to tenant_tier on alert rules and kept tenant_id on the debug/trace exporter only. Updated PR to reflect that.
Emily Chen (2026-02-20): How deterministic is the guilt score around synthetic sessions? Could we get false positives from truncated prompts?
Asha Menon (2026-02-20): We added a synthetic session tag check and a short cooldown window (30s) to avoid scoring on transient truncations. Added unit tests covering truncated prompt cases.
Samir Patel (2026-02-22): Needs an inline comment explaining why we weight kvMissRate higher. Also please add a short runtime cost estimate for emitting these metrics (tokens/sec overhead).
Asha Menon (2026-02-22): Added comments and microbenchmark numbers to stream_chunk_meter.go: ~0.4% CPU delta at 10k streaming rps in our perf lab.
merge_details: Merged via squash on 2026-02-25 by Diego Ramos. Post-merge: deployed staging stack with feature flag enabled for 48h, created rollout RFC note on eng-oncall channel, and scheduled a canary toggle to 10% of streaming sessions for 2026-03-02. Observability docs updated and linked in the console feature flags page.
